name: COMO Parrot Cay, Turks & Caicos
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive private island resort spans 1,000 pristine acres in the untouched Turks & Caicos archipelago, where celebrity guests and discerning travelers escape to one of the Caribbean's most coveted hideaways.
whats_special: COMO Parrot Cay is the only resort on its own private island in Turks & Caicos, featuring a world-renowned COMO Shambhala spa that attracts A-listers seeking holistic wellness treatments. The resort sits on a designated nature reserve, protecting nesting sites for endangered sea turtles and rare bird species, while offering some of the clearest waters in the Caribbean with visibility up to 200 feet.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the overwater spa pavilion during sunset – it's the only overwater spa in Turks & Caicos and offers unparalleled views of the North Caicos channel while maintaining complete privacy.
dont_miss: The resort's pristine mile-long beach consistently ranks among the world's best, and the surrounding waters offer exceptional bonefishing – considered some of the finest flats fishing in the Caribbean. Take the complimentary kayak to explore the nearby uninhabited cays, or time your visit during turtle nesting season (April-October) for guided night walks to witness hawksbill and green turtles.
pros: Private island sanctuary with pristine white sand beaches
Award-winning COMO Shambhala spa with holistic wellness treatments
Luxurious beachfront villas and suites with stunning ocean views
World-class diving and snorkeling in crystal-clear waters
Exceptional farm-to-table dining with fresh local ingredients
cons: Remote location requires boat transfer from Providenciales
Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive private island setting
